results.reply: Oh, aye, I've heard the tidings. Sure, the village is abuzz with the news of the newcomer. Who is it, do ye think?
Oh, sure I do. He was out there with the sheep, and he stumbled over a rock. He was down for a few days, but he's a strong man, he is. He's back to work now, sure he is.
Sure, I'll be there when the time is right. Ye'll know when to call me.
